method: Full WinApi.cs source reading and exact pinned Git blob verification. No native API executed.
findings: GetProcessPath uses OpenProcess limited-information access and closes successful handle in finally. Path buffer is fixed260 characters with no retry on insufficient buffer; failed query returns null without distinguishing reason. Negative pid converts to uint without explicit validation.

FindWindow/FindWindowEx/RealGetWindowClass string declarations omit explicit Unicode charset, whereas some other declarations use Auto or Unicode. Non-ASCII matching needs runtime verification; reviewed class names are generally ASCII.

GetWindowClassName ignores native returned length/error. IsWindowHasClassName sizes buffer from requested name length; truncation can make longer names indistinguishable from prefixes. This is a static prefix-match concern, not a runtime reproduction.
FindAllWindowsEx is a lazy live enumeration, not an atomic snapshot. Window creation/destruction during iteration can affect observed set.

AccessibleObjectFromPoint is declared returning nint although result is treated conceptually as status; x86/x64 ABI and HRESULT interpretation require qualification. No automatic exception conversion or status validation is provided by this wrapper.
GetWindowLong/SetWindowLong expose int values, suitable only for intended narrow style fields, not a general pointer-width accessor. SetWindowLong lacks SetLastError configuration here.
RestoreWindowToForeground ignores final retry result. Many native return values remain caller responsibility; declarations alone do not establish successful hook, window, PIDL or input operation.
limits: No Windows API reference/ABI runtime validation; static concerns not asserted as reproduced failures. No dedup library production change.
148/500 repositories fully reviewed; ExplorerTabUtility partial83/104. Native pHash investigation deferred.
